SELECT g.PTL_GRP_CD AS ptlGrpCd, COALESCE(ml.RES_VAL, d.PTL_GRP_NM) AS ptlGrpNm, COALESCE(md.RES_VAL, d.PTL_GRP_DESC) AS ptlGrpDesc, g.POLLING_INTVAL AS pollingIntval, g.TIMEOUT_MS AS timeoutMs, g.RETRY_CNT AS retryCnt, g.USE_YN AS useYn, g.SORT_ORD AS sortOrd, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ju_protocol p WHERE p.PTL_GRP_CD = g.PTL_GRP_CD AND p.USE_YN = 'YENO0001') AS protocolCount FROM ju_protocol_group g LEFT JOIN ju_protocol_group_detail d ON d.PTL_GRP_CD = g.PTL_GRP_CD LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang ml ON ml.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND ml.RES_KEY = d.PTL_GRP_NM_KEY LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang md ON md.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND md.RES_KEY = d.PTL_GRP_DESC_KEY WHERE 1 = 1
AND (g.PTL_GRP_CD LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(ml.RES_VAL, d.PTL_GRP_NM) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY g.SORT_ORD, g.PTL_GRP_CD

SELECT g.PTL_GRP_CD AS ptlGrpCd, COALESCE(ml.RES_VAL, d.PTL_GRP_NM) AS ptlGrpNm, COALESCE(md.RES_VAL, d.PTL_GRP_DESC) AS ptlGrpDesc, g.POLLING_INTVAL AS pollingIntval, g.TIMEOUT_MS AS timeoutMs, g.RETRY_CNT AS retryCnt, g.USE_YN AS useYn, g.SORT_ORD AS sortOrd, d.PTL_GRP_NM_KEY AS ptlGrpNmKey, d.PTL_GRP_DESC_KEY AS ptlGrpDescKey, g.FRAME_RULE AS frameRule, g.CMD_GAP_MS AS cmdGapMs, g.INIT_ROUTINE AS initRoutine, g.INIT_DELAY_MS AS initDelayMs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ju_protocol p WHERE p.PTL_GRP_CD = g.PTL_GRP_CD AND p.USE_YN = 'YENO0001') AS protocolCount FROM ju_protocol_group g LEFT JOIN ju_protocol_group_detail d ON d.PTL_GRP_CD = g.PTL_GRP_CD LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang ml ON ml.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND ml.RES_KEY = d.PTL_GRP_NM_KEY LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang md ON md.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND md.RES_KEY = d.PTL_GRP_DESC_KEY WHERE g.PTL_GRP_CD = #{ptlGrpCd}
SELECT USE_YN FROM ju_protocol_group WHERE PTL_GRP_CD = #{ptlGrpCd}

UPDATE ju_protocol_group_detail SET PTL_GRP_NM = COALESCE(#{ptlGrpNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PTL_GRP_NM), PTL_GRP_DESC = COALESCE(#{ptlGrpDesc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PTL_GRP_DESC) WHERE PTL_GRP_CD = #{ptlGrpCd}

SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(edg.EXP_ID, ':', p.PTL_CD) FROM ju_protocol p JOIN ju_experiment_data_group edg ON p.PTL_CD IN (edg.START_PTL_CD, edg.PAUSE_PTL_CD, edg.STOP_PTL_CD) AND edg.USE_YN = 'YENO0001' JOIN ju_experiment e ON e.EXP_ID = edg.EXP_ID AND e.USE_YN = 'YENO0001' WHERE p.PTL_GRP_CD = #{ptlGrpCd} AND p.USE_YN = 'YENO0001' ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(edg.EXP_ID, ':', #{ptlCd}) FROM ju_experiment_data_group edg JOIN ju_experiment e ON e.EXP_ID = edg.EXP_ID AND e.USE_YN = 'YENO0001' WHERE #{ptlCd} IN (edg.START_PTL_CD, edg.PAUSE_PTL_CD, edg.STOP_PTL_CD) AND edg.USE_YN = 'YENO0001' ORDER BY 1

mapper.select: SELECT p.PTL_GRP_CD AS ptlGrpCd, p.PTL_CD AS ptlCd, p.PTL_TYPE AS ptlType, COALESCE(tl.RES_VAL, td.COM_NM) AS ptlTypeNm, p.PTL_LEN AS ptlLen, p.PTL_VAL AS ptlVal, COALESCE(ml.RES_VAL, d.PTL_NM) AS ptlNm, COALESCE(md.RES_VAL, d.PTL_DESC) AS ptlDesc, d.PTL_NM_KEY AS ptlNmKey, d.PTL_DESC_KEY AS ptlDescKey, p.PTL_ROLES AS ptlRoles, p.PTL_ACTION AS ptlAction, p.EXPECT_RULE AS expectRule, p.IDEMPOTENT_YN AS idempotentYn, p.USE_YN AS useYn FROM ju_protocol p LEFT JOIN ju_protocol_detail d ON d.PTL_GRP_CD = p.PTL_GRP_CD AND d.PTL_CD = p.PTL_CD LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang ml ON ml.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND ml.RES_KEY = d.PTL_NM_KEY LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang md ON md.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND md.RES_KEY = d.PTL_DESC_KEY LEFT JOIN ju_com_code_detail td ON td.GRP_CD = 'PROT' AND td.COM_CD = p.PTL_TYPE LEFT JOIN ju_multi_lang tl ON tl.LANG_CD = #{langCd} AND tl.RES_KEY = td.COM_NM_KEY WHERE p.PTL_GRP_CD = #{ptlGrpCd} AND p.PTL_CD = #{ptlCd}
